logp.method_description: The n-octanol/water coefficients of the complexes were determined as previously reported (99) using a shake-flask method. (23) Buffered-saline distilled water (100 mL, phosphate buffer [PO43–] = 10 mM, [NaCl] = 0.15 M, pH 7.4) and n-octanol (100 mL) were shaken together for 72 h to allow saturation of both phases. Approximately 1 mg of the complexes was dissolved in 5 mL of the aqueous phase, and 5 mL of the organic phase was added, mixing for 10 min. The resulting emulsion was centrifuged to separate the phases. The concentration of the compounds in each phase was determined using UV–vis absorbance spectroscopy. log D7.4 was defined as log{[compoundorganic]/[compoundaqueous]}.
